title: Federation reference concurrent same-key publication intermittently returns 500 (gate test-917ea3ef)
outcome: Diagnose and correct the intermittent concurrent same-key reference-publication failure on the existing master implementation, independently of NOFILE. Preserve exact intent/descriptor/marker authority and classify product, test or environmental cause from captured evidence.
acceptance: The original failed gate and exact source bases are preserved, and a bounded stop-on-first-failure reproduction captures contender status/body plus the underlying error, stage and SQLite code sufficiently to classify the cause; absence of reproduction is reported as inconclusive, not a passing diagnosis.

A cause-specific fix or disposition is independently reviewed without weakening publication authority, existing assertions, retry policy or timing budgets; any product behavior change receives the required scope decision before implementation.
A deterministic regression for the identified mechanism and the maintained full gate pass on the exact final input; diagnostic stress iterations are not reported as quality-gate PASS.
